name: Lusting
overview: Scripture reveals that lust is a serious issue of the heart, equated by Jesus with committing adultery internally when one looks with lust (Matthew 5:28). The believer is called to make a covenant with their eyes to avoid entertaining such thoughts (Job 31:1). Lust arises from the flesh, which is in conflict with the Spirit, but walking in the Spirit enables one to overcome these desires (Galatians 5:16-17). Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh along with its passions and lusts, affirming the necessity of a transformed life to resist sin (Galatians 5:24), since all have sinned and fall short of God's glory (Romans 3:23).
